title: Tech or Treat
description: Enjoy family-friendly science fun at The Tech Interactive with Halloween twists on favorite exhibits during the museum's annual Tech or Treat event.
sourceDescriptionRaw: Join us for scientific chills and tech-tastic thrills at our annual Tech or Treat event on Saturday, Oct. 31. Enjoy family-friendly science fun at The Tech with Halloween twists on favorite exhibits. All ages are welcome.
address: 201 S Market St, San Jose, CA 95113

title: The Great Big BOO!
description: A family-friendly Halloween celebration at Gilroy Gardens with live musical shows, trick-or-treating along the BOO Trail, character encounters, and interactive Halloween experiences.
sourceDescriptionRaw: The Great Big BOO is an immersive Halloween experience that’s full of fun for the whole family. Come in costume, enjoy the live musical shows, and discover new adventures as you explore the park after dark! Come in costume and follow the BOO Trail throughout the park to go trick-or-treating for candy. Help save Halloween with your Interactive Pumpkin Wand! Find all 8 BOO Zones to uncover the hidden message. Sing and dance along during The Great Big BOO live musical show—and then catch up with all your favorite BOO Alley friends at character encounters throughout the park.
ageSource: Gilroy Gardens official Halloween event page

title: Big Book Sale (Gran venta de libros) of the Friends of the Gilroy Library
description: The Friends of the Gilroy Library host a monthly big book sale on the second Saturday of each month, with books to browse and buy for visitors of all ages.
sourceDescriptionRaw: The Friends of the Gilroy Library invite eveyone to our monthly big book sale! This special sale is held on the second Saturday of every month. All ages are welcome to browse and find a great deal!
ageSource: Santa Clara County Library District official event listing

title: Glass Pumpkin Festival
description: Stroll through thousands of hand-blown glass pumpkins, watch live glassblowing demonstrations, and browse unique glass art from Bay Area and visiting artisans.
sourceDescriptionRaw: Stroll through thousands of hand-blown glass pumpkins crafted by artists from the Bay Area Glass Institute and renowned glass artisans from around the country. The free public event includes live glassblowing demonstrations using a mobile hotshop trailer, with unique glass art available for purchase. Schedule: Friday, October 2 from 3 pm–9 pm; Saturday, October 3 from 10 am–9 pm; Sunday, October 4 from 10 am–5 pm.
costEvidence: The organizer describes this as a free public event.

title: Nightfall
description: Follow the trail of clues through a house reclaimed by nature, into a glowing woodland, and all the way to a witch's hidden village, where a century-old enchantment is finally coming undone.
sourceDescriptionRaw: By day, Filoli is breathtaking. By night, the mystery begins. Start your evening at a lively harvest celebration filled with pumpkins, live music, seasonal food and drinks, festive games, and autumn charm. Then venture into the Historic House, where nature has slowly reclaimed every room and a century-old mystery waits to be uncovered. Follow the story beyond the mansion onto a glowing woodland trail lined with illuminated jack-o'-lanterns, towering scarecrows, giant glowing slugs, and artistic woodland installations before arriving at the Witches' Village hidden beneath the redwoods.

title: Santa Clara City Library Comic Con
description: Families can explore Artist Alley, meet comic creators, play tabletop games, watch anime screenings, pose for photos, and make geek-friendly crafts during this all-ages celebration at Central Park Library.
sourceDescriptionRaw: Comic Con is back for 2026 at Central Park Library with an all-ages celebration of comics, creativity, and fandom, including panels, creator signings, photo ops, hands-on workshops, Artist Alley, tabletop gaming, anime screenings, a Comic Book Pavilion, a photo booth, and geek-friendly crafts. Admission is free.

title: Magical Glass Pumpkin Patch
description: Wander among thousands of one-of-a-kind handmade glass pumpkins on the Los Gatos High School lawn, meet the artists behind them, and browse the colorful fall display while supporting school programs.
sourceDescriptionRaw: The Magical Glass Pumpkin Patch returns to Los Gatos High School for its 24th year, transforming the front lawn with thousands of one-of-a-kind handmade glass pumpkins. Visitors can meet the artists and shop the display, with proceeds supporting Los Gatos High School programs.

title: Mountain View Oktoberfest
description: A family-friendly weekend festival in Downtown Mountain View with live German music, dancing, contests, authentic food, and a festive Bavarian atmosphere.

title: Palo Alto Rocks! A Music Party in the Park
description: Kick off Palo Alto Museum's opening season with a free afternoon of live music at Heritage Park, plus local music trivia, ice cream, prizes, and a chance to meet the museum team.

sourceDescriptionRaw: Fun Fest 2026 runs October 9 through 11 at St. Lucy Parish School. The weekend schedule includes live bands, the St. Lucy School Choir, a live auction, alumni activities, and other community festivities.
